newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock funds post outflows in 3-day period.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock funds post outflows in 3-day period.

text.p: U.S. stock mutual funds posted net new cash outflows of $812 million for the three days ended March 20 compared to inflows of $477 million for the previous two days ended March 17, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracking firm said that aggressive growth funds recorded outflows of $416 million compared to outflows of $60 million, and growth funds had outflows of $356 million versus outflows of $13 million. International funds posted outflows of $231 million versus inflows of $197 million.

Trim Tabs said bond funds recorded lower outflows of $110 million, compared with $461 million. Muni funds experienced a reversal to inflows of $33 million from outflows of $239 million, while government/GNMA funds had outflows of $88 million versus outflows of $136 million.
Corporate/income/global funds had outflows of $77 million versus outflows of $117 million.
